name: SWI/SNF related BAF chromatin remodeling complex subunit C1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: SMARCC1 encodes SWI/SNF complex subunit SMARCC1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to SMARCC1-associated developmental dysgenesis syndrome (autosomal dominant).
